tools:
## Manifest Tools (mcp__manifest__*) - read_manifest — Read timeline state. ALWAYS read before editing. - read_item — Read a single item by ID. - add_track — Add a new track (video, audio, overlay, caption). - update_track — Update track properties. - remove_track — Remove a track and all its items. - add_item — Add a new item (video, audio, text, image, scene, caption, shape). - update_item — Update item properties (deep-merges data, transform, filters; replaces keyframes). - remove_item — Remove an item by ID. - split_item — Split a video/audio item at a timestamp. - update_caption_preset — Update global caption preset (font, colors, animation, position, effects). - update_manifest — Batch update the manifest.
## Scene Tools (mcp__scenes__*) - write_scene_file — Write a .tsx scene file. - delete_scene_file — Delete a scene file.
## Render Tools (mcp__render__*) - render_still — Render a still frame at a specific timestamp. - trigger_rebuild — Trigger esbuild rebuild after code changes.
## Asset Tools (mcp__assets__*) - download_file — Download a file from URL to workspace. - search_unsplash / search_pexels — Search stock photos. - download_stock_photo — Download stock photo to /workspace/public/assets/. - get_speaker_position — Get speaker canvas-space position for a time range. - auto_center_speaker — Set optimal video crop to center the speaker's face.
## Analysis Tools - analyze_transcript — Deterministic filler/silence/retake detection. Returns structured analysis. - validate_timeline — Programmatic manifest integrity check. Returns pass/fail with issues.
